chemical.zh: Metabolism指的是你体内的化学过程，尤其是那些处理食物的过程。

chain.en: Let's hear again from Professor Alexandra Johnstone, talking to BBC World Service's The Food Chain.

chain.zh: 在这条链条的沿途，有银行家、经纪人、投资者和购房者。

chain.en: Like we are top of the well-known food chain, but bacteria viruses eat us.
chain.zh: 我们虽然是已知食物链的顶端，但细菌和病毒会吃掉我们。

chain.zh: Willis 还认为必要时将国王用链子锁在椅子上。

charity.zh: 家庭虐待慈善机构认为，该节目将家庭暴力轻描淡写。

charity.zh: 出席伦敦这场慈善活动的还有太空科学家 Dr Maggie Aderin-Pocock，她本人也患有读写障碍。

character.en: These stereotypes suggest that poverty is the result of bad choices or weak character.

character.en: Chinese characters, for example, use symbols instead of letters of the alphabet to represent words and ideas.
character.zh: 例如，汉字使用符号而不是字母表中的字母来代表单词和想法。

chronic.en: Chronic is derived from the Greek “kronos” and means “related to time”.
chronic.zh: “chronic”源自希腊语“kronos”，意思是“与时间相关的”。

chronic.en: She has a chronic illness, and when it flared up, she'd missed work.
chronic.zh: 她患有慢性病，当病情发作时，她就会旷工。

chronic.en: Feeling overwhelmed and unable to cope with life can become chronic, meaning that it lasts for a long time.
chronic.zh: 感到不堪重负且无法应对生活可能会变成慢性的，意味着它会持续很长时间。

chronic.en: OK, let’s recap the vocabulary from this episode, beginning with the adjective chronic, which means continuing for a long time.
chronic.zh: 好了，让我们回顾一下本期节目的词汇，从形容词 chronic 开始，意思是持续很长时间。

chronic.en: And I say relative because there are many parts of the world where there are just like these constant chronic wars that are waging.
chronic.zh: 我说相对，是因为世界上许多地方仍然存在着持续不断的慢性战争。

chew.en: It traps you into a pathway that just chews up time.
chew.zh: 它把你困在一条只会消耗时间的路径上。

chew.en: What I don't want to see is any loud chewing, or with your mouth open, please and thank you!
chew.zh: 我不想看到的是大声咀嚼，或者张着嘴吃饭，拜托了，谢谢！

chew.en: There's more chaos than there was before!" because they've bitten off [too much that] more than they can chew.
chew.zh: 怎么比以前更乱了！”因为他们咬得太大，咽不下去。

chew.en: Lots of ideas to chew over there, Neil. But now, isn't it time you revealed the answer to your question?
chew.zh: 有很多值得深思的想法呢，Neil。不过现在，是不是该公布你问题的答案了？

chew.en: It tells our bodies to get ready for the raw and rough fibre needed to develop our chewing muscles and teeth.
chew.zh: 它告诉我们的身体准备好迎接发育咀嚼肌和牙齿所需的生硬纤维。

chicken.en: Which is exactly what happened at successful restaurants like Kentucky Fried Chicken and McDonald’s.
chicken.zh: 这正是像 Kentucky Fried Chicken 和 McDonald’s 这样的成功餐馆所发生的事情。

chicken.en: Let's go get some chicken wings. There was somebody accepting you despite your failure.
chicken.zh: 我们去吃炸鸡翅吧。有人在接受你，尽管你失败了。

chicken.en: And I said fried chicken, was I right? You are absolutely correct.
chicken.zh: 我说是炸鸡，我对了吗？你完全正确。

chicken.en: Livestock are animals and birds that are kept on a farm, such as cows, sheep or chickens.
chicken.zh: 牲畜（livestock）是指在农场饲养的动物和家禽，如牛、羊或鸡。

chicken.en: I don't even know what to call it. It's like a little squad of chickens.
chicken.zh: 我甚至不知道该叫它什么。这就像一小队鸡。

challenge.en: And finally, coping strategies are psychological ways of managing your emotions in challenging situations.
challenge.zh: 最后，应对策略是在具有挑战性的情况下管理情绪的心理方式。

challenge.en: Then there is the biggest personal challenge I will face in 2026, becoming a father.
challenge.zh: 接下来是我在 2026 年将面临的最大个人挑战：成为一名父亲。

challenge.en: Another significant challenge is that asteroids typically rotate, often unpredictably and at varying speeds.
challenge.zh: 另一个重大挑战是小行星通常会旋转，而且往往是毫无规律地以不同的速度旋转。

challenge.en: And those who faced the consequences were those who dared to challenge most openly.
challenge.zh: 而那些面临后果的人，正是那些敢于最公开挑战的人。

challenge.en: Transporting stone and building large temples in such a difficult environment is a challenge.
challenge.zh: 在如此困难的环境中运输石头并建造大型寺庙是一个巨大的挑战。

champion.en: The working-class champion needed the billionaire's blessing to get through the door.
champion.zh: 这位工人阶级的斗士需要亿万富翁的祝福才能敲开这扇大门。

champion.en: You’re a champion. So, but let me ask you this, in retrospect were all of these quits good?
champion.zh: 你是个冠军。所以，让我问你这个，回过头来看，所有这些退出都是好事吗？

champion.en: And can a man whose career was funded by one of Silicon Valley's wealthiest investors really be the champion of forgotten America?
champion.zh: 一个职业生涯由硅谷最富有的投资者资助的人，真的能成为被遗忘的美国的斗士吗？

champion.en: By promoting this radical vision, he positioned himself as the moderniser and the champion of Saudi youth, earning huge popular support.
champion.zh: 通过推行这一激进的愿景，他将自己塑造成为现代化主义者和沙特青年的拥护者，赢得了巨大的民众支持。

champion.en: Silvia trains eight hours a day, six days a week, under the guidance of her coach, who's also her mum and a former artistic swimming champion herself.
champion.zh: Silvia 在教练的指导下，每周训练六天，每天训练八小时。她的教练也是她的妈妈，而且她妈妈本身也是前花样游泳冠军。

channel.en: The city included agricultural sites, temples, homes, storage areas, water channels.
channel.zh: 这座城市包括农业区、寺庙、住宅、仓储区、水渠。

channel.en: There were TV infomercials on Rio’s TV channels.
channel.zh: 里约的电视频道上有电视购物广告。

channel.zh: 顺便说一句，你可以在我们的 YouTube 频道上找到许多关于如何做到这一点的演示和教程。

channel.zh: 嗯，你可以在任何获取 BBC 播客的地方收听我们，或者在 BBC World Service 的 YouTube 频道上观看我们。

channel.en: Let me give you an example. There’s a popular YouTube channel called Drumeo, where they invite some of the world’s best drummers to perform in their studio.
channel.zh: 我举个例子。有一个名为 Drumeo 的热门 YouTube 频道，他们邀请世界上一些最优秀的鼓手到他们的工作室表演。

chestnut.en: That's anything from blackberries and chestnuts to mushrooms and wild garlic.
chestnut.zh: 从黑莓、栗子到蘑菇和野蒜，什么都有。

chip.zh: 然而，英国料理却让人联想到酒吧、炸鱼薯条和煎炸早餐。

chip.zh: 土豆起源于南美洲。但没有人会认真争论炸鱼薯条不是英国菜。

chip.zh: 这感觉就像炸鱼薯条、湿漉漉的沙滩椅和令人失望的夏天天气一样充满英国味。

chip.en: But not everywhere is so in love with potato chips.
chip.zh: 但并非到处都如此热爱薯片。

chaos.zh: 在他的粉丝看来，他是拯救者，是埃及制止混乱所需要的强人。

chaos.zh: 这个年轻的国家面临着经济问题、政治混乱和外国入侵。

cheerful.en: Getting rid of clutter makes us feel uplifted – cheerful, happy and more positive.
cheerful.zh: 摆脱杂物让我们感到振奋——快乐、高兴且更积极。

cheerful.en: The adjective uplifted means feeling cheerful, happy and optimistic.
cheerful.zh: 形容词“振奋的”意味着感到高兴、快乐和乐观。

cheerful.en: Christmas Island sounds like a cheerful and festive place.
cheerful.zh: 圣诞岛听起来像是一个欢乐而有节日气氛的地方。

cheerful.en: Hardly surprising, perhaps. Another tracked changes in national mood based on how cheerful or gloomy song lyrics became over the course of decades.

chop.en: First time I've chopped an onion like this and it's so neat and easy.

chop.zh: 毕业后，凭借大量磨炼军事技能的机会，他迅速晋升。

chop.en: Now, we’ll be going into this in much more detail in part three, but in short, this well-known Saudi journalist went into the consulate, was murdered and then chopped to pieces with a bone saw.
chop.zh: 我们将在第三集中详细讨论这个问题，简而言之，这位著名的沙特记者进入领事馆后被谋杀，然后被用骨锯分尸。

charge.en: They were also charged and imprisoned. Then volunteers came to keep the shop open.
charge.zh: 她们也遭到起诉并被判入狱。接着志愿者们前来继续维持店铺运营。

charge.en: Of course, the charges weren’t real, and the participants knew they were part of an experiment.
charge.zh: 当然，这些指控都不是真的，参与者也知道自己是在参加一场实验。

charge.zh: 在那里，他们被采集指纹、拍照，并被指控犯下持械抢劫之类的罪名。

charge.zh: 他被指控、受审并因参与犯罪阴谋罪被判有罪。

charge.zh: 当局发出了逮捕令，以谋杀罪通缉 Wyatt Earp。

characteristic.en: Ethnicity means the social, cultural and linguistic characteristics shared by a group of people.
characteristic.zh: “族群”（Ethnicity）意味着一群人所共享的社会、文化和语言特征。

characteristic.en: One characteristic of a confident English speaker is that they prioritize communication over perfection.
characteristic.zh: 自信的英语说者有一个特点，那就是他们把沟通看得比完美更重要。

characteristic.en: Because you've already been assembling a bunch of those loans with those characteristics in play somewhere, right?
characteristic.zh: 因为你手里已经攒了一大批带有这些特征、正在审批流程中的贷款了，对吧？

characteristic.en: And I think that is a characteristic that I have.
characteristic.zh: 我认为这确实是我的一种特质。

characteristic.en: And so back to the point about the news media, you can put your attention on the news but that's how you're spending the real currency of life so just be aware of that if you want to that's fine there's no there's no right or wrong here like maybe it is your destiny to pick something in the news learn about that problem adopt that problem and solve it but just be careful because your attention is the only thing that you have and that can also be captured by your own past yes you can fritter it away on anything you like is there an advantage to starting out as a loser absolutely yeah yeah because if you're because if you're a loser then you'll want to be a winner and then you'll develop all the characteristics that'll help you be a you know quote-unquote winner in life that said i wouldn't sentence my kids to it like i don't think you can artificially do that you know it's sort of like imagine that you were you know 300 years ago you're born a surf and then somehow you managed to escape off the farm and you become a landowner and then eventually you become minor nobility an aristocrat.
characteristic.zh: 所以回到新闻媒体的话题，你可以把注意力放在新闻上，但那就是你在消耗生命真正货币的方式，所以如果你想这样做，请意识到这一点。这没问题，没有所谓的对错，也许你的命运就是去关注新闻中的某件事，了解那个问题，接纳那个问题并解决它，但要小心，因为你的注意力是你拥有的唯一东西，它也可能被你自己的过去所俘获。是的，你可以把它浪费在任何你喜欢的事情上。从失败者开始有优势吗？绝对有。因为如果你是一个失败者，你就会想成为赢家，然后你就会培养出所有能帮助你成为——你知道，所谓的——人生赢家特质。话虽如此，我不会让我的孩子们经历这些，我不认为你可以人为地做到这一点。你知道，这就像想象一下，300年前你出生为一个农奴，然后你以某种方式设法逃离了农场，成为了地主，最终成为了小贵族。

chamber.en: Echo chambers are spaces where people mostly see content they already agree with.
chamber.zh: 回音室是指人们主要看到自己已经认同的内容的空间。

chamber.en: The other chamber is called the House of Lords, which has around 800 members.
chamber.zh: 另一个议院被称为上议院（House of Lords），大约有800名成员。

chamber.zh: 最重要的是，诸如TikTok或Instagram上的个性化信息流会制造回音室。

chamber.zh: 在内部，议会有两个所谓的议院。

chamber.en: In January of this year, January of 2026, the German Chancellor, Friedrich Merz, stood in front of the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in Dessau and admitted, in no uncertain terms, that his country, Germany, had made a mistake.
chamber.zh: 今年1月，也就是2026年1月，德国总理 Friedrich Merz 站在德绍工商会前，毫不含糊地承认他的国家——德国，犯了一个错误。

charcoal.en: It was wood, for the most part. Sometimes dried grass, peat, charcoal, or animal dung.
charcoal.zh: 大部分是木头。有时是干草、泥炭、木炭或动物粪便。

charcoal.zh: 这是人类第一次设法用煤而不是用木炭、烧过的木头来炼铁。

chase.en: I was surprised and frightened. Now the rat was chasing me.
chase.zh: 我又惊又怕。这下变成老鼠在追我了。

chase.en: He bounced from place to place, chasing the next opportunity.
chase.zh: 此后他辗转各地，四处寻找下一个机会。

chase.en: My friends and I used to chase them around with sticks.
chase.zh: 我和朋友们经常拿着棍子追打它们。

chase.en: Should I chase this thing or not? I can make a fair judgment on that as opposed to being so swayed.
chase.zh: 我应该追求这个还是不应该？我可以对此做出公正的判断，而不是轻易被左右。

chase.en: But it's the cat and the cheese. It's like, we're looking for cheese, but we have all these cat behind us and all we have to do is look and remember that they're behind us and chasing us.
chase.zh: 但这就是猫和奶酪的故事。我们是在寻找奶酪，但我们身后有这么多猫，我们所要做的就是回头记住它们就在我们身后追赶我们。

chairman.en: It is probably Quotations from Chairman Mao or The Little Red Book.
chairman.zh: 它很可能是《毛主席语录》或称《小红书》。

chairman.en: However, the Bible, the Quran, and Quotations from Chairman Mao are not really commercial bestsellers.
chairman.zh: 然而，《圣经》、《古兰经》和《毛主席语录》并非真正意义上的商业畅销书。

chairman.en: He lowers the voting age to fourteen. He is a big fan of Chairman Mao, and this is his version of Mao's Red Guards, a cultural revolution in miniature, on three small volcanic islands in the Indian Ocean.
chairman.zh: 他把投票年龄降到了十四岁。他是毛主席的崇拜者，而这就是他版本的“红卫兵”——在印度洋的三个小火山岛上上演的微缩版“文化大革命”。

charming.en: When journalists visit and ask him about his role, he is charming and unhelpful.
charming.zh: 当记者前来采访并问及他的角色时，他风趣幽默却不提供任何有用信息。

chapter.en: And then, in 1607, something happened that closed a chapter of Irish history for good.
chapter.zh: 接着，在 1607 年，发生了一件彻底终结爱尔兰历史某一章节的事情。

chapter.en: He seemed to embody a golden future, a new chapter for Rome.
chapter.zh: 他似乎体现了一个金色的未来，罗马的新篇章。

chapter.en: Instead of publishing the entire book at once, writers would release their story chapter by chapter in newspapers or magazines.
chapter.zh: 作家们不会一下子出版整本书，而是会在报纸或杂志上一章一章地发表他们的故事。

chapter.en: Instead of publishing the entire book at once, writers would release their story chapter by chapter in newspapers or magazines.
chapter.zh: 作家们不会一下子出版整本书，而是会在报纸或杂志上一章一章地发表他们的故事。

chapter.en: Or Read one English book every two months, by reading a chapter or two chapters every Saturday and every Sunday.
chapter.zh: 或者每两个月读一本英文书，方法是每个星期六和星期日读一章或两章。

charter.en: The results? Both traditional public schools and charter schools are doing worse academically.
charter.zh: 结果呢？传统公立学校和特许学校的学业表现在下降。

charter.en: Take the West Michigan Aviation Academy, which is a charter school founded by the DeVoses.
charter.zh: 以西密歇根航空学院为例，这是一所由DeVos夫妇创立的特许学校。

charter.en: These were societies that needed contracts, charters, and legal expertise.
charter.zh: 这些都是需要合同、特许状和法律专业知识的社会。

charter.en: The Security Council has a special kind of power under the UN Charter which is the main legal document that explains how the UN works.
charter.zh: 根据《联合国宪章》（即阐述联合国运作方式的主要法律文件），安理会拥有一种特殊的权力。

charter.en: At a meeting in San Francisco, representatives from 50 countries agreed on the UN Charter, the set of rules for how the organisation would work.
charter.zh: 在旧金山的一次会议上，来自50个国家的代表就《联合国宪章》达成一致，这是一套关于该组织如何运作的规则。

cherish.en: If Caligula died, which seemed highly probable, he could point at how dedicated he had been to the emperor, and how he'd been willing to fight and most probably die in the arena for his cherished master.
cherish.zh: 如果 Caligula 去世了，这看起来极有可能，他就可以指出自己对皇帝是多么忠诚，为了他心爱的主人，他甚至愿意在竞技场中战斗并很可能牺牲。

chest.en: Hardy later said that reading Ramanujan’s work was like “opening a treasure chest full of mathematical jewels.”
chest.zh: Hardy后来评价说，阅读Ramanujan的作品就像是“打开了一个装满数学珍宝的宝箱。”

chest.en: A group of colonists boarded a British ship in Boston Harbor and dumped hundreds of chests of tea into the water.
chest.zh: 一群殖民地居民登上波士顿港的一艘英国船只，把数百箱茶倒进了水里。

chest.en: As he was about to address the boys, two of his trusted Praetorian guards pounced on him, stabbing him a total of 30 times in the neck, chest and genitals.
chest.zh: 正当他准备对男孩们讲话时，他信任的两名禁卫军突然扑向他，在脖子、胸部和生殖器上总共捅了30刀。

chest.en: So if you encounter something, you learn from something, you're reflecting upon the learning, then you can reflect upon it, absorb it, and then just move on. but sitting there saying i'm chris i'm nabal i deserve this this happened to me that person wronged me this is who i am this shouldn't have happened i need to go get revenge on this or i need to fix that or change this i mean that i think is where a lot of mental illness is you know comes from so it depends if you are thinking about something to solve a problem and get it off your chest and get it off your mind if it leaves your mind clearer at the end of it then i think it was worthwhile.
chest.zh: 所以，如果你遇到了什么事，从中学到了东西，你在反思这次学习，那么你可以反思它、吸收它，然后继续前进。但如果坐在那里说“我是Chris，我是Naval，我理应得到这个，这事发生在我身上，那个人亏待了我，我就是这样的人，这本不该发生，我得去报复，或者我得去修复那个、改变这个”，我认为很多心理疾病就是这么来的。所以这取决于你思考某事是为了解决问题、把它从心头放下，还是为了别的。如果思考结束后你的头脑更清醒了，那我觉得是值得的。

cheer.en: The crowds in Tahrir Square danced and cheered, the dictator was gone.
cheer.zh: 解放广场上的人群载歌载舞，欢呼雀跃，独裁者倒台了。

cheer.en: Why might I want to cheer myself up? Well, perhaps because I'm going to do something creative.
cheer.zh: 我为什么会想让自己振作起来呢？也许是因为我接下来要做一些需要创造力的事情。

cheer.en: And does it ever go the other way, where you're also trying to cheer up your mother at all, or take care of her spirits?
cheer.zh: 有没有反过来，你也会尝试逗你母亲开心，或者照顾她的精神？

cheer.en: The U.S., wary of losing an ally, avoided calling it a coup, while Gulf states like Saudi Arabia cheered, glad to see the Brotherhood crushed.
cheer.zh: 美国唯恐失去一个盟友，避免称其为政变，而沙特阿拉伯等海湾国家则欢呼雀跃，很高兴看到兄弟会被粉碎。

cheer.en: For example, “mate” and “cheers” are common in British slang; while “dude” or “awesome” are more American; Australians might say “arvo” for afternoon or “no worries” instead of your welcome.
cheer.zh: 例如，“mate”和“cheers”在英式俚语中很常见；而“dude”或“awesome”则更偏美式；澳大利亚人可能会用“arvo”表示下午，或者用“no worries”代替不客气。

choke.en: If a girl screamed in court and said she saw Sarah Good’s spectre choking her, that was enough.
choke.zh: 如果一个女孩在法庭上尖叫，说她看见萨拉·古德的幽灵在掐她，这就足够了。

choke.en: His tricks were clever: he could send ‘ spectres,’ invisible spirits, to pinch or choke you in the night.
choke.zh: 他的伎俩非常高明：他可以派遣“幽灵”（即无形的精魂）在夜里掐你或勒你。

chalk.en: And it has paints and watercolors and chalks and everything you can imagine.
chalk.zh: 里面有颜料、水彩、粉笔以及你能想象到的一切。

chalk.en: There are photos of him, the President, standing in front of a blackboard, chalk in hand, demonstrating the new style of writing.
chalk.zh: 有照片记录下他这位总统手拿粉笔站在黑板前，示范新书写方式的情景。

chill.en: But perhaps the most chilling example of Putin’s ruthlessness has been his invasion of Ukraine.
chill.zh: 但普京冷酷无情最令人毛骨悚然的例子，或许莫过于他对乌克兰的入侵。

chill.en: It's pretty chill. Torey describes it like this-- You know, we order probably three or four bottles of Cristal at a $1,000 a bottle.
chill.zh: 挺轻松的。托雷是这么形容的——你知道的，我们大概会点三四瓶水晶香槟，每瓶1000美元。

chimney.en: Nuclear power stations would have no ugly black smoke coming out of the top, there would be no dusty coal trucks driving in and out of the plant every day, there would just be harmless water vapour coming out of a large chimney.
chimney.zh: 核电站顶部不会冒出难看的黑烟，没有满载灰尘的运煤卡车每天进出电厂，高大的烟囱里只会冒出无害的水蒸气。

chemistry.en: Every scientific field, from physics to chemistry to computer science, depends on mathematical thinking.
chemistry.zh: 每一个科学领域，从物理学、化学到计算机科学，都依赖于数学思维。

chemistry.en: In 1911, Marie Skłodowska- Curie received her second Nobel Prize this time in Chemistry.
chemistry.zh: 1911 年，Marie Skłodowska-Curie 获得了她的第二个诺贝尔奖，这一次是化学奖。

chemistry.en: This concept opened the door to entirely new fields of physics and chemistry.
chemistry.zh: 这一概念为物理学和化学开辟了全新的领域。

chemistry.en: Marie Skodowska Curie changed medicine and chemistry.
chemistry.zh: Marie Skodowska Curie改变了医学和化学。

chess.en: At his chess matches, he frequently violated the social norms of the game, arriving late and refusing to make eye contact with the player sitting across from him.
chess.zh: 在比赛中，他常常违反棋坛的社交礼仪，迟到，还拒绝与坐在对面的棋手有任何眼神接触。

chess.en: In October 1967, the world's greatest chess minds gathered in Sousse, Tunisia, to face off at the Interzonal Tournament, the high stakes gateway to the World Chess Championship.
chess.zh: 1967年10月，世界上最顶尖的国际象棋高手齐聚突尼斯苏塞，参加区际赛——那是通往世界国际象棋锦标赛的高风险门槛赛事。

charm.en: And I was so charmed by this. And more importantly, he could tell I was nervous.
charm.zh: 我当时觉得他这样说真是很有魅力。更重要的是，他看出了我很紧张。

charm.en: But we don't realize that oftentimes the moment of bad is the explosion. but everything around it is charisma and charm and jokes.
charm.zh: 但我们没有意识到，往往坏的时刻就是爆炸。但周围的一切都是魅力、魅力和笑话。

characterize.en: I can't really improve on the way you characterized it.
characterize.zh: 你刚才的概括，我实在没法讲得更好了。

chart.en: This is the iTunes billboard chart. And it is zero sum.
chart.zh: 这是iTunes告示牌排行榜。而且它是零和博弈。

cheek.en: It's going to get eaten by a tiger. so this kid is starting off on the wrong foundation the the one i mentioned earlier about the idea that babies don't feel pain like that's ludicrous right um i've never heard that before it's such a wild yeah i'm not saying that's 100 true i read it on i read it child in the cheek quite hard and that's in the category of i read it on twitter and i did one level confirmation on it but it's so ludicrous that i should probably do two or three level confirmations on it before i talk about it um but there are definitely some people who believe that They're enough that it was a thing in certain circles for a while.
cheek.zh: 它会被老虎吃掉的。所以这个孩子从一开始就建立在错误的基石上。我之前提到的那个关于婴儿感觉不到疼痛的想法，那太荒谬了，对吧？嗯，我以前从未听说过，这太离谱了。是的，我不是说那是百分之百真实的，我是在网上读到的，在脸颊上用力捏一下，这属于那种“我在Twitter上读到的，我只做了一层确认”的范畴，但它太荒谬了，我在谈论它之前可能应该做两到三层确认。嗯，但确实有一些人相信这一点，以至于它在某些圈子里流行了一段时间。
